text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisian Prime Minister Hamed Karoui expected in Morocco on a two-day visit starting Tuesday.
- Iranian envoy visits Morocco, bearing a message from President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani for King Hassan.
- Tensions might ease within Arab Maghreb Union after King Hassan and Algerian President Liamine Zeroual exchanged messages on independence day.
- General Secretary of Journalists Union Larbi Messari reelected.
